title: Test Feature
problem: This is a test of the new feature development studio
desired_outcome: Confirm that the intake record can be entered, exported, validated, and reviewed; no MJobs product functionality is requested.
constraints: No production job application or applicant-data changes
Do not modify the MJobs capability/requirement acceptance catalogues
Do not start autonomous agents or merge without human review

acceptance_criteria.description: The smoke-test specification validates against the v1 field rules and is covered by an automated regression test.
The browser form can export a specification compatible with the v1 validator.

notes: Requested as a P0 test of the studio, not a real P0 MJobs product deficiency. A schema validation PASS does not make AC-001/AC-002 PASS without recorded evidence on a reviewed revision.
